office: the Ministry of Labour, Immigration and Population

routes.label: at a township immigration and population office, or a mobile issuing project

note: Myanmar's national registration card, also known as the citizenship scrutiny card, is issued by the Ministry of Labour, Immigration and Population, including through mobile projects that issued nearly 200,000 cards in Mandalay to students, locals and orphans (The Global New Light of Myanmar, January 2019, as UNHCR reproduces it). The fee, the age from which it is issued, its term and the time weren't found.

sources.title: UNHCR Operational Data Portal, Nearly 200,000 NRCs Issued in Mandalay (from The Global New Light of Myanmar, January 2019)
sources.said: National registration cards (NRCs) also known as citizenship scrutiny cards, were issued to students, locals, and orphans from 28 townships of Mandalay Region under the Thitsa project at the Mandalay City Hall in Chanayethazan Township on 25 January.
